mechanism: Triamcinolone (corticosteroid) can cause sodium retention and fluid accumulation, which may antagonize the antihypertensive effects of candesartan and increase hyperkalemia risk through opposing mechanisms on potassium handling.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly, serum electrolytes (particularly potassium), and renal function; adjust candesartan dose if needed and use the lowest effective corticosteroid dose for the shortest duration possible.
